children.html:
Explore Deeper Waters

Drift Diving at Mocean Beach Resort

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-2f8e098a elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Experience the thrill of drift diving in the clear, current-swept waters around West Sumbawa. At Mocean Beach Resort, our PADI-certified guides lead small groups through underwater channels where gentle to moderate currents carry you effortlessly past vibrant reefs and schooling fish. These boat dives showcase soft corals, reef sharks, turtles, and pelagic species while you glide along with the flow. With a maximum of two divers per instructor, you’ll enjoy a safe, relaxed, and unforgettable deep sea adventure.

children.html:
Your Drift Diving Experience

Effortless Exploration

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-2d67115b elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: A typical drift diving day begins with a short boat ride to select sites where tides create smooth, manageable currents. After a detailed safety briefing and current check, you’ll descend with your guide and let the ocean carry you along spectacular reef walls and coral gardens. Our team monitors conditions carefully, adjusting each dive to ensure a balanced mix of excitement and comfort. Whether you’re a seasoned deep sea diver or new to current diving, our instructors will help you perfect buoyancy and drift techniques.

Facilities Built for Divers

Dive Center Excellence

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-8ab0c2b elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Mocean Beach Resort is fully equipped to support drift diving adventures. Our dive center features private gear lockers, spacious wet areas, a dedicated rinse station, and an air-conditioned camera room for post-dive reviews. From pre-dive planning to surface pickup, every detail is designed to keep you safe, comfortable, and ready for the next underwater ride.

Calm After Currents

Relax, Recharge, and Discover Sumbawa

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-1211fb4b elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Your dive adventure doesn’t end when you surface. Mocean Beach Resort offers quiet beaches, breathtaking sunsets, and easy access to Sumbawa’s hidden gems. Spend an afternoon exploring nearby villages, trek to cascading waterfalls, or simply unwind with a spa treatment after a day of diving. Whether you crave exploration or pure relaxation, our boutique setting lets you enjoy Indonesia’s natural beauty at your own pace. Every stay is designed to refresh your body and inspire your next dive.

Experience More Than Diving

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-7d9f9f09 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Beyond the crystal-clear waters, Sumbawa invites you to explore its wild side. Hike scenic coastal trails, visit traditional fishing villages, or take a day trip to secluded beaches where you can swim, snorkel, and soak in untouched beauty. For those seeking culture, local markets and ceremonies reveal the island’s rich heritage. Whether you’re chasing adrenaline or peaceful escapes, every moment here adds a new layer to your Indonesian journey.

children.html:
Who can try drift diving?

Certified divers with some open water experience are best suited for drift diving adventures.

How strong are the currents?

Currents range from gentle to moderate, designed to carry divers safely along reefs while providing excitement.

What marine life can I see?

Expect turtles, reef sharks, schooling fish, soft corals, and occasional pelagic species in crystal-clear waters.

How large are the dive groups?

Groups are limited to two divers per instructor for safety, personalized attention, and comfort.

Are the facilities equipped for drift dives?

Yes. Our dive center includes private gear lockers, wet areas, a rinse station, and an air-conditioned camera room.
